item.title: viebBook 2.6.5
item.description:
Mac 2.6.5 polishes sidebar dragging, Search and device pairing.
- The dragged book replaces its original row, stays aligned to the sidebar, and glides into its destination on release. The insertion line and freely moving pointer are retained. - Haptic profiles use one native tap instead of repeated pulse bursts. Rapid boundary jitter is filtered out. - Search sits below a plain title bar with aligned controls and cleaner surfaces. Volltext/Titel can be selected before typing and the selection survives page changes. Long result titles stay bounded with full-title tooltips. - The pairing sheet has fixed header/footer areas and a scrolling body, preserving padding when extra options expand. QR paper and its quiet zone use one mild off-white shade with sharp black modules. Helper copy is shorter.
Includes signed Sparkle updates from the public downloads repository, cached AI readiness/model information, compact chat input with Shift-Enter newlines, clearer advanced settings inputs and the taller sidebar arrangement sheet.
Validation: seven native drag, single-tap haptic and search tests passed; three QR tests passed, including decoding and uniform, unblurred paper/module checks. Dark and light Search/Settings fixtures were inspected. Release app and Sparkle framework signatures were verified.
Apple silicon, macOS 14 or newer. LAN sync requires macOS 15. Ad-hoc signed: use right-click → Open on first installation if macOS asks. Older builds with the private update URL require one manual installation.

item.title: viebBook 2.6.4
item.description:
Mac 2.6.4 corrects the updater's access to its feed and installers. Signed updates are now served from a separate public downloads repository, while the application's source repository stays private. GitHub Actions verifies the archive and Ed25519 signature before public publication.
Includes the 2.6.3 improvements: reliable sidebar dragging with a column-aligned preview and freely moving pointer; taller arrangement sheet and clearer advanced settings inputs; cached AI connection/model information; a compact chat input with Shift-Enter for newlines; and simpler QR pairing.
Validation: native drag, composer and Settings checks passed. The complete app bundle and Sparkle helpers passed strict code-signature verification. The public feed was checked without credentials, and both private and public signing verifiers accepted a real signed archive.
Apple silicon, macOS 14 or newer. LAN sync requires macOS 15. Ad-hoc signed: use right-click → Open on the first launch if macOS asks. Older builds pointing at the private update feed need this one manual installation.
